verses.original: Ὥστε μου ἀδελφοί ἀγαπητοὶ καὶ ἐπιπόθητοι μου χαρὰ καὶ στέφανός οὕτως στήκετε ἐν Κυρίῳ ἀγαπητοί
verses.transliteration: Hōste mou adelphoi agapētoi kai epipothētoi mou chara kai stephanos houtōs stēkete en Kyriō agapētoi
verses.literal: Therefore my brothers whom I love and long for my joy and crown that is how you must stand firm in [the] Lord my beloved

verses.original: παρακαλῶ Εὐοδίαν καὶ παρακαλῶ Συντύχην τὸ αὐτὸ φρονεῖν ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: parakalō Euodian kai parakalō Syntychēn to auto phronein en Kyriō
verses.literal: I urge Euodia and - Syntyche vvv vvv to agree [with each other] in [the] Lord

verses.original: ναὶ καὶ ἐρωτῶ σέ γνήσιε σύζυγε συλλαμβάνου αὐταῖς αἵτινες συνήθλησάν μοι ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ καὶ μετὰ Κλήμεντος καὶ τῶν λοιπῶν μου συνεργῶν ὧν τὰ ὀνόματα ἐν βίβλῳ ζωῆς
verses.transliteration: nai kai erōtō se gnēsie syzyge syllambanou autais haitines synēthlēsan moi en tō euangeliō kai meta Klēmentos kai tōn loipōn mou synergōn hōn ta onomata en biblō zōēs
verses.literal: Yes and I ask you [my] true yokefellow to help these [women] who have contended at my side for the gospel along with Clement and the rest of my fellow workers whose - names [are] in [the] Book of Life

verses.original: Χαίρετε ἐν Κυρίῳ πάντοτε ἐρῶ πάλιν χαίρετε
verses.transliteration: Chairete en Kyriō pantote erō palin chairete
verses.literal: Rejoice in [the] Lord always I will say [it] again Rejoice

verses.original: ὑμῶν τὸ ἐπιεικὲς γνωσθήτω πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις ὁ Κύριος ἐγγύς
verses.transliteration: hymōn to epieikes gnōsthētō pasin anthrōpois ho Kyrios engys
verses.literal: {Let} your - gentleness be apparent to all . . . The Lord [is] near

verses.original: μεριμνᾶτε Μηδὲν ἀλλ’ ἐν παντὶ τῇ προσευχῇ καὶ τῇ δεήσει μετὰ εὐχαριστίας γνωριζέσθω ὑμῶν τὰ αἰτήματα πρὸς τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: merimnate Mēden all’ en panti tē proseuchē kai tē deēsei meta eucharistias gnōrizesthō hymōn ta aitēmata pros ton Theon
verses.literal: Be anxious for nothing but in everything by prayer and - petition with thanksgiving present your - requests to - God

verses.original: καὶ ἡ εἰρήνη τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡ ὑπερέχουσα πάντα νοῦν φρουρήσει ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας καὶ ὑμῶν τὰ νοήματα ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai hē eirēnē tou Theou hē hyperechousa panta noun phrourēsei hymōn tas kardias kai hymōn ta noēmata en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: And the peace - of God which surpasses all understanding will guard your - hearts and your - minds in Christ Jesus

verses.original: Τὸ λοιπόν ἀδελφοί ὅσα ἐστὶν ἀληθῆ ὅσα σεμνά ὅσα δίκαια ὅσα ἁγνά ὅσα προσφιλῆ ὅσα εὔφημα εἴ τις τις ἀρετὴ καὶ εἴ ἔπαινος λογίζεσθε ταῦτα
verses.transliteration: To loipon adelphoi hosa estin alēthē hosa semna hosa dikaia hosa hagna hosa prosphilē hosa euphēma ei tis tis aretē kai ei epainos logizesthe tauta
verses.literal: - Finally brothers whatever is true whatever [is] honorable whatever [is] right whatever [is] pure whatever [is] lovely whatever [is] admirable if anything [is] excellent [or] - praiseworthy think on these things

verses.original: καὶ ἃ ἐμάθετε καὶ παρελάβετε καὶ ἠκούσατε καὶ εἴδετε ἐν ἐμοί πράσσετε ταῦτα καὶ ὁ Θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης ἔσται μεθ’ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: kai ha emathete kai parelabete kai ēkousate kai eidete en emoi prassete tauta kai ho Theos tēs eirēnēs estai meth’ hymōn
verses.literal: - Whatever you have learned or received or heard [from me] or seen in me put it into practice . . . And the God - of peace will be with you

verses.original: δὲ Ἐχάρην μεγάλως ἐν Κυρίῳ ὅτι ἤδη ποτὲ ἀνεθάλετε τὸ φρονεῖν ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ ἐφ’ ᾧ καὶ ἐφρονεῖτε δέ ἠκαιρεῖσθε
verses.transliteration: de Echarēn megalōs en Kyriō hoti ēdē pote anethalete to phronein hyper emou eph’ hō kai ephroneite de ēkaireisthe
verses.literal: Now I rejoice greatly in [the] Lord that vvv at last you have revived [your] concern for me vvv vvv vvv You were indeed concerned but you had no opportunity [to show it]

verses.original: ὅτι οὐχ λέγω καθ’ ὑστέρησιν γὰρ ἐγὼ ἔμαθον εἶναι αὐτάρκης ἐν οἷς εἰμι
verses.transliteration: hoti ouch legō kath’ hysterēsin gar egō emathon einai autarkēs en hois eimi
verses.literal: - vvv I am not saying this out of need for I have learned to be content regardless of my circumstances . . . . . .

verses.original: οἶδα καὶ ταπεινοῦσθαι καὶ οἶδα περισσεύειν ἐν παντὶ καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν μεμύημαι καὶ χορτάζεσθαι καὶ πεινᾶν καὶ περισσεύειν καὶ ὑστερεῖσθαι
verses.transliteration: oida kai tapeinousthai kai oida perisseuein en panti kai en pasin memyēmai kai chortazesthai kai peinan kai perisseuein kai hystereisthai
verses.literal: I know - [how] to live humbly and I know [how] to abound In any and - every situation I have learned the secret - of being filled and being hungry - of having plenty and having need

verses.original: ἰσχύω πάντα ἐν τῷ ἐνδυναμοῦντί με
verses.transliteration: ischyō panta en tō endynamounti me
verses.literal: I can do all things through [Christ] who gives me strength . . .

verses.original: Πλὴν ἐποιήσατε καλῶς συνκοινωνήσαντές μου τῇ θλίψει
verses.transliteration: Plēn epoiēsate kalōs synkoinōnēsantes mou tē thlipsei
verses.literal: Nevertheless you have done well to share in my - affliction

verses.original: δὲ ὑμεῖς Φιλιππήσιοι καὶ οἴδατε ὅτι ἐν ἀρχῇ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου ὅτε ἐξῆλθον ἀπὸ Μακεδονίας οὐδεμία ἐκκλησία εἰ μὴ ὑμεῖς μόνοι ἐκοινώνησεν μοι εἰς λόγον δόσεως καὶ λήμψεως
verses.transliteration: de hymeis Philippēsioi kai oidate hoti en archē tou euangeliou hote exēlthon apo Makedonias oudemia ekklēsia ei mē hymeis monoi ekoinōnēsen moi eis logon doseōs kai lēmpseōs
verses.literal: And as you Philippians - know - in [the] early days of the gospel when I left . . . Macedonia no church but . . . you - partnered with me in the matter of giving and receiving

verses.original: ὅτι καὶ ἐν Θεσσαλονίκῃ ἐπέμψατε εἰς μοι τὴν χρείαν καὶ ἅπαξ καὶ δὶς
verses.transliteration: hoti kai en Thessalonikē epempsate eis moi tēn chreian kai hapax kai dis
verses.literal: For even [while I was] in Thessalonica you provided for my - needs vvv again and again

verses.original: Οὐχ ὅτι ἐπιζητῶ τὸ δόμα ἀλλὰ ἐπιζητῶ τὸν καρπὸν τὸν πλεονάζοντα εἰς ὑμῶν λόγον
verses.transliteration: Ouch hoti epizētō to doma alla epizētō ton karpon ton pleonazonta eis hymōn logon
verses.literal: Not that I am seeking a gift but I am looking for the fruit that may be credited to your account

verses.original: δὲ ἀπέχω πάντα πεπλήρωμαι καὶ περισσεύω δεξάμενος παρ’ ὑμῶν τὰ παρὰ Ἐπαφροδίτου εὐωδίας ὀσμὴν δεκτήν θυσίαν εὐάρεστον τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: de apechō panta peplērōmai kai perisseuō dexamenos par’ hymōn ta para Epaphroditou euōdias osmēn dektēn thysian euareston tō Theō
verses.literal: - I have all I need and more now that I have received vvv your gifts from Epaphroditus [They are] a fragrant [offering] . . . an acceptable sacrifice well-pleasing - to God

verses.original: δὲ μου Ὁ Θεός πληρώσει πᾶσαν ὑμῶν χρείαν κατὰ αὐτοῦ ἐν δόξῃ τὸ πλοῦτος ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: de mou Ho Theos plērōsei pasan hymōn chreian kata autou en doxē to ploutos en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: And my - God will supply all your needs according to His vvv glorious - riches in Christ Jesus

verses.original: δὲ τῷ ἡμῶν Θεῷ καὶ Πατρὶ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: de tō hēmōn Theō kai Patri hē doxa eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn amēn
verses.literal: - To our God and Father [be] glory vvv vvv forever [and] ever Amen

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε πάντα ἅγιον ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ οἱ ἀδελφοί σὺν ἐμοὶ Ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe panta hagion en Christō Iēsou hoi adelphoi syn emoi Aspazontai hymas
verses.literal: Greet all the saints in Christ Jesus The brothers who are with me send you greetings . . .

verses.original: πάντες οἱ ἅγιοι Ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς δὲ μάλιστα οἱ ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας Καίσαρος
verses.transliteration: pantes hoi hagioi Aspazontai hymas de malista hoi ek tēs oikias Kaisaros
verses.literal: All the saints send you greetings . . . - especially those from the household of Caesar

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ ὑμῶν τοῦ πνεύματος
verses.transliteration: Hē charis tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou meta hymōn tou pneumatos
verses.literal: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ [be] with your - spirit
